text: Security is a crucial part of web development. First, websites should use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. Second, authentication helps confirm that users are who they say they are, usually through passwords or two-factor methods. Third, input validation is important because it checks the data users enter and prevents harmful code from being processed. Developers must also understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, so they can protect their applications. By combining these practices, developers can build safer websites and protect users' personal information from attackers.
